pages.text: Fight bosses — the best weapons in the pack drop only from them, and every kill banks Combat-lane tokens.$(br2)Each tier has required progression bosses and optional trophy bosses. $(bold)Simply Swords unique weapons$() are boss-drop-only: every one of the 42 uniques is matched to a specific boss. You cannot craft them, trade for them, or find them in chests.

$(bold)Boss Mods Active$()$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Brutal Bosses$() — Structure-guarding mini-bosses, all tiers$(li)$(bold)Meet Your Fight$() — Named T3 superbosses (Swampjaw, Bellringer, Dame Fortuna, Rosalyne)$(li)$(bold)Mutant Monsters$() — Overworld + dimensional mutant variants$(li)$(bold)Terramity$() — Structure bosses from Tier 1 up$(li)$(bold)Cataclysm$() — T3–T4 ultra-bosses in massive structures$(li)$(bold)Ultimate Bosses$() — T4 optional superbosses$(li)$(bold)Stalwart Dungeons$() — T3 dungeon bosses$(li)$(bold)Iron's Spellbooks$() — Boss spellcasters in all tiers

$(bold)Progressive Bosses$()$(br2)This mod runs the Wither you summon. It does $(bold)not$() make a boss stronger each time it is killed: your first Wither and your tenth are the same fight.$(br2)A Wither built with $(bold)Corrupted Soul Sand$() is stronger than a plain one. The pack keeps one of those forms, the $(l:icraft:bosses/t4_bosses)Ultimate Wither$(/l): a Tier 4 challenge in the Nether.

$(bold)Bosses & Progression$()$(br2)Boss kills feed the $(bold)Combat$() lane of the Codex token economy — every kill banks progression tokens, more at higher tiers. They also count toward the $(bold)boss rush$(): clear $(t2)80%$() / $(t3)90%$() / $(t4)100%$() of a tier's bosses to advance without banking tokens at all.$(br2)Boss $(italic)materials$() drop alongside, but they are spoils for crafting — not progression currency.$(br2)$(bold)Next: run /icraft codex bosses, then open $(l:icraft:bosses/t1_bosses)Tier 1 Bosses$(/l).$()
